item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a steady rhythm, with early mornings, a midday stretch, and a busy afternoon. That's exactly when water slips your mind. Dehydration quietly drains focus and patience, and you'll want both today. Don't wait for thirst. Tie water to moments you already have: before meditation, before you head out for a walk, and with dinner. Action: pour a full glass of water right now and finish it.
